Hi Rachel,

We're kicking off the SOC2 evidence collection for CedarBank's audit window and have a few targeted asks around Vulnerability Management. Can you please provide the following artifacts and short attestation?

- Scan cadence for internal/external/ authenticated scans (frequency + last run date)

We prefer delivery via your secure upload link or DocuSign for the attestation PDF. If you can send an initial package within 48 hours that would be ideal.

Rachel / Monica — attaching the artifacts requested. See summary below and the attestation language at the end. Attachments: redwood_vm_scan_index_20271011.csv, cve_remediation_manifest_20271012.pdf

Summary (short):
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated internal scans; external unauthenticated scans every 72 hours; container/image scans daily as part of CI; last full authenticated run: 2027-10-11T03:15:22Z (export attached).
- SLAs (operational targets): Critical = 48 hours (time-to-remediate/mitigate), High = 7 days, Medium = 30 days, Low = 90 days. Note: Critical SLA includes immediate mitigation steps and automatic segregation where required. These are our operational remediation SLAs and are used to drive runbooks; contractually we provide the same timeframes for Dedicated/Private customers under approved commitments.
- Proof of closure: the attached manifest lists CVE IDs, detection date, ticket references, remediation date, and closure evidence links for all critical/high items within the last 90 days. All critical CVEs (CVE-2027-1421 and CVE-2027-2087) were closed (remediated and validated) within 36 and 44 hours respectively; evidence links included in the manifest.
- Exceptions/legacy components: two legacy appliances (internal IDs: legacy-db-01, legacy-ldap-02) are currently in compensating-control mode; we maintain additional network segmentation and compensating monitoring for those systems. These are listed in the manifest with expected replacement windows (Q1 2028).

Attestation (to be signed):
"Redwood Inference confirms that the Vulnerability Management program described in this package represents current operational practice as of 2027-10-12. Scan cadence and remediation SLAs stated above are followed for production assets; critical and high CVEs identified in the last 90 days have associated remediation tickets and closure proof linked in the manifest. Exceptions are documented and covered by compensating controls pending replacement."

I can convert the attestation to a DocuSign-ready PDF (soc2-vm-attestation-docusign.pdf) and upload to SecureShare if that is preferred.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
